exposure: gestational age at gestational diabetes diagnosis
fasting blood glucose level at gestational diabetes diagnosis
outcome: Need for insulin therapy vs medical nutrition therapy alone
cohort: 3317 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus between 1992-2015
finding: A validated model using seven predictors was able to predict the need for insulin therapy and the likelihood of adverse perinatal outcomes in women with gestational diabetes mellitus.
mod_finding: The study mentions cesarean delivery as an adverse outcome predicted by the model but doesn't specifically link it to mode of delivery as a predictor.
